verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's docs include an api-reference section with code snippets (e.g., fetch-a-web-page.md) and quickstart examples like page.ai()/page.extract(), showing static example code, but there's no evidence of an interactive, runnable API console — probes for openapi/swagger specs all returned 404s, indicating no auto-generated interactive reference. missing for 10: evidence of an actual interactive/try-it API explorer, runnable code sandboxes, or OpenAPI-based interactive docs.
